title: Improvement Phase 2026-2027
author: Derek Sarmiento
desc: **Improvement Phase 2026-2027** is designed to elevate your training intensity and refine your lifting technique. With 5 days of focused workouts, you'll engage in targeted exercises like Lying Leg Curls and Hack Squats to build strength and muscle endurance. Each session emphasizes proper form and controlled movements, ensuring you maximize gains while minimizing injury risk. Get ready to push your limits and see tangible improvements in your performance!
